SCT_Apartment.text: ALEX AND MIRA'S APARTMENT — Modest, warm contemporary apartment with open window drapes, coffee, a short hallway and practical morning light.

SCT_PatternSpace.text: PATTERN SPACE — Subjective theatrical plane of graphite grids, vectors, marginalia, coded notation, recursive marks and layered visual logic.

SCT_Transit.text: CITY STREETS / SUBWAY — Sidewalk stone, train platforms, tunnels, phone glow, crosswalk timing and compressed public movement.

SCT_Park.text: PARK / QUIET CITY EDGE — Small public green space or river-edge bench set apart from the main pedestrian flow.

SCT_Marquee.text: EMPTY MARQUEE / NIGHT STREETS — Flickering bulbs, closed storefronts, reflective glass and familiar city corners after dark.

SCT_RehearsalRoom.text: REHEARSAL ROOM — Functional rehearsal space with piano, music stands, chairs, wall posters and enough open stage area for theatrical expansion.

SCT_Workshop.text: COMMUNITY WORKSHOP — Flexible hall for music and movement with removable floor tape, chairs in an imperfect circle, simple instruments and found percussion.

SCT_Rooftop.text: ROOFTOP — Open skyline, cold air, parapet walls and broad negative space.

SCT_Club.text: LATE-NIGHT CLUB / DANCE FLOOR — Dense rhythm, soft practical light, moving bodies and a close, unglamorous urban dance floor.

SCT_Cafe.text: CORNER CAFÉ — Coffee steam, counter seating, familiar smells, street-facing windows and small neighborhood-scale details.

SCT_CityTableau.text: CITYWIDE TABLEAU — Modular theatrical combination of screens, windows, sidewalks, transit and private rooms.
